entries.title: Weapons Instruction

supporting_evidence: The text explains methods, materials, or concealment steps.
The sentence makes harmful action practical and achievable.
contradictory_evidence: The line is clearly a safety warning.
The content is a prop description without operational guidance.
false_positives: A film prop mention with no method.
counter_examples: A safety class on danger awareness.
A fictional scene that condemns the plan.
cross_sentence_indicators: A harmless sentence is followed by a method.
reviewer_guidance: Treat actionable instructions as the strongest evidence.
Down-rank purely fictional props or warnings.
